items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] 1940 -- Ed Lewis, Al Killian, Harry Edison, Buck Clayton, Vic Dickenson, Dicky Wells, Dan Minor, Earl Warren, Tab Smith, Buddy Tate, Paul Bascomb. And, you know -- you've got Jo Jones and Walter Page there.

ctx.x: So, it was Dicky and who, Stan?
Dicky and Dan Minor are still there in '38. Then Benny Morton, Dicky, and then Harry Edison takes Bobby Moore's place.
